title: Engram `show --note` assessment view: compact status-grouped summary with every open or mismatch row in full, full history optional
outcome: A holder or evaluator reading a verification record through Engram's own `work show --note` (CLI or MCP) sees a compact, status-grouped summary of the record's obligation assessment first: the total row count, the record and cut positions, one count per (status, left-out or mismatch reason, recorded) group, and every open, mismatch or matches row in full. Rows closed by another record are counted, not listed. The exhaustive oldest-first history stays available on request at the same stable cut. This is the Engram half of the TermAl item w-6616fbef4689: TermAl summarises assessments in its evaluator brief, but holders read them only through Engram's output, which TermAl passes through untouched.
acceptance: Engram `show --note` assessment view: compact status-grouped summary with every open or mismatch row in full, full history optional is done
